text.text: Cisco Catalyst 4510R Switch
Front View
The Catalyst 4510R+E switch is a 10-slot horizontal chassis supporting redundant power supplies, redundant supervisor engines, and slots for up to nine modules.

graphic.text: The Catalyst 4510R+E switch is a 10-slot horizontal chassis supporting redundant power supplies, redundant supervisor engines, and slots for up to nine modules.

text.text: Rear View
12-port, 10-Gigabit Ethernet module

Cisco UPOE 48-port intelligent 60 W PoE1 per port (maximum of 1500 W per module) 10/100/1000 Ethernet module. Module supports 48 ports at 30 W per port simultaneously or 24 ports at 60 W per port simultaneously.

graphic.text: Cisco UPOE 48-port intelligent 60 W PoE1 per port (maximum of 1500 W per module) 10/100/1000 Ethernet module. Module supports 48 ports at 30 W per port simultaneously or 24 ports at 60 W per port simultaneously.

text.text: Catalyst 4500E 48-Port UPOE with 12 Multigigabit ports, and 36 10/100/1000 ports. This module supports the Cisco Multigigabit technology for 802.11ac Wave2 and 10GBASE-T speeds. Can be configured in three modes: Mode 1 - Multigigabit Lite Mode 2 - Multigigabit Enhanced Mode 3 - Multigigabit Performance

4510R+E Power Supply

Supports one or two power supplies. text.text: 4510R+E Power Supply

Source AC can be out of phase between multiple power supplies or multiple AC-power plugs on the same power supply because all AC power supply inputs are isolated. First power supplies are installed in the left power supply bay. The second power supply is installed in the right power supply bay.

graphic.text:
Source AC can be out of phase between multiple power supplies or multiple AC-power plugs on the same power supply because all AC power supply inputs are isolated.
First power supplies are installed in the left power supply bay. The second power supply is installed in the right power supply bay.

text.text: The chassis supports a single hot-swappable fan tray. One fan tray model is available:WS-X4582+E. The fan tray contains ten individual fans. Fan tray STATUS LED (located on the fan tray front panel) Red—One or more individual fans have failed Green—Fan tray is operating normally.
